title: Rap History
text: Hip-hop has always been extremely competitive especially between the generations You know, you always got to pay homage to the pioneers that put it down before us because if it wasn't for them We wouldn't be here. It's a respect thing I've always been a student of hip-hop these new rappers coming out getting deals without even knowing the history of the game. It's crazy Perhaps there's no better example of this than budding SoundCloud rapper Lil doo doo Do the gang do the gang do the gang do the gang Okay, because controversy recently when he came publicly did he's never heard rap before 2009 My influences are sometimes I listen to old-school hip-hop, you know, you know, like Soulja Boy Bow-wow sometimes Nick Cannon you feel I think Hillary Clinton should have won You do do's attitude rubbed many hip-hop pioneers the wrong way most notably 1970s rappers the soul crush crew Man, I don't think on his face must be seeping into his brain. This is an old school in the soul crush crew I don't know about real hip-hop I don't even recognize a new junk boy looking like that. She would not have made it back in my day Where it all started? Let me take you back 1978 the Bronx New York broken glass rats and roaches Abandoned buildings we had to dress tough not like this class I don't hear who any blade she broke her and I'm DJ Grand Wizard Karate Good all leather everything change spikes fingerless gloves and absolutely no underclothes fur coat broaches See we was a group so we had to match my thing was Indian Dresses and chaps cuz I'm Chief Bronco Always what karate pants cuz my beats was kicking. I Never wore drawers swang Soul crush crew Thinking about popping pills and sipping lean please these drugs are frying your brain The only choice we ever did was reefer with a little bit of crack in it I make this a joke don't even have a DJ Raps was clear and concise and everything makes sense Debudibedebe Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on, hold on, let's take five, everyone. Y'all, I talked to these dudes, guys, we cool now. You feel me? We smoked some weed. With a little bit of crack in it.
